name: Julia Bloodstone
original_name: ユーリア · ブラッドストーン
source:
Colonel of the Space Federation Army belonging to the New Solar faction.
After a great deal of success in the Hermes conflict, she gained the position of a senior officer at a young age.
Originally a talented woman who showed outstanding results at the military academy, she has a high ability in hand-to-hand combat. Some members of the military have been trying to accuse her of even the slightest injustice.

In addition, because of her brilliant skills, the Neo-Terrans group has feelings of strong hatred. While having a good mind and excellent operational ability, she has little knowledge about relationships.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=922863&gc=gcl]Getchu[/url]]
